newsitem.title: FRANCE: Mayor of Algiers killed during gunbattle.
newsitem.headline: Mayor of Algiers killed during gunbattle.

text.p: The mayor of Algiers was killed in the Algerian capital on Monday when he was apparently hit by a stray bullet from a gunbattle between Moslem guerrillas and security forces, residents and officials said.

A resident reached by telephone said "it seems" that Mayor Ali Boucetta was hit by a stray bullet in Telemely district of Algiers as the security forces were storming a nearby hideout for Islamist rebels. A government official confirmed Boucetta's death but gave no details.
